title: OS command execution via execute_command_line (fortran) — review required
description: The fortran sink execute_command_line launches processes. Untrusted input in the command becomes command injection. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms arguments are trusted or passed as vectors via validated command plus wait.
remediation: Use validated command plus wait with separate arguments, never interpolated command strings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any execute_command_line call matches. Other languages' launchers are separate rules.
